# Unity

Host-test-only source subset from [ThrowTheSwitch/Unity](https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/Unity),
release v2.7.0, commit `b6763fbd9cedfacaa89e2ad9fd00d615a234e355`.

Vendored files: `src/unity.c`, `src/unity.h`, `src/unity_internals.h` and
`LICENSE.txt`. Source files are unchanged. The MIT license is retained here.
No Unity code is linked into the shared core or kernel. No download is needed to
build or run the suite. Review and pin updates explicitly.
